flow_strategy_principle.description: The directed edges (Account→AddressBook→Contact/ContactGroup) form a clear ownership chain; therefore the primary flow is Top-Down. The self-loop on ContactGroup (parent nesting) is rendered as a short re-entry arrow that returns to the same row, keeping the overall downward rhythm intact.

spatial_breathing_principle.description: Root level (Account) receives 20 px margin to isolate it as the entry point; AddressBook gets 10 px margin to visually group its children; Contact and ContactGroup leaves use 5 px padding internally for compactness and 10 px margin between siblings to keep the diagram airy without sprawling.

alignment_balance_principle.description: All class rectangles are similar medium size, so use 'median' alignment to produce a balanced, almost square grid. This prevents overly tall or wide rows and keeps the inheritance/ownership arrows short and readable.

depth_layering_principle.description: No nested containers exist, only flat classes; assign index 10 to all nodes so every class sits on the same plane and arrows render cleanly underneath any overlapping labels.

structural_rhythm_principle.description: The entire diagram behaves as one compact tier: medium boxes, moderate spacing, and a tight top-down flow. The eye moves from Account at the top, fans out to AddressBook below, and then fans again to Contact & ContactGroup on the lowest row, creating a small, balanced triangle of classes.

detailed_comments.Source_A_LayoutDesignAgent_generated: No explicit groups were supplied, so layout is driven solely by the four nodes and their directed edges. The ownership chain (Account→AddressBook→{Contact,ContactGroup}) dictates a clean three-row top-down layout; the ContactGroup self-loop is treated as an internal horizontal return rather than a new hierarchical level.
